title: Tube laser cutting machines
subtitle: NovoTech value line · ULT two- and three-chuck tube and pipe lasers · Ø0.4 to 14.2″ · 20 to 39 ft bars · 1.5 to 40 kW
cover_line: NovoTech value line · built in China to North American standards · sold & serviced in Canada by NovoTech
about_title: Round, square and profile tube cut to length with every hole, cope and notch in one pass
about_text: A tube laser cuts round, square, rectangular and open profiles to length and cuts the holes, copes, slots and notches in them in one pass, straight from the 3D model — no saw, no drill, no notcher, no layout. The ULT carries the bar in double-acting pneumatic chucks with servo-following supports and cuts it with a 1.5 to 40 kW source: four chuck sizes for round tube from Ø0.4 to 14.2″ and square to 13.8″, bars of 20, 29.5 or 39 ft and up to 2,205 lb. The three-chuck version cuts the last part without a remnant; pneumatic loaders, bundle feeding to 5 tonnes, a ±45° five-axis bevel head and TubesT nesting are options.

NovoTech Machine Tools sells, installs and supports sheet-metal and fabrication machinery across Canada from Mississauga, ON, Canada. The value line is our own brand: machines built in China to our specification with established components — Raycus, MAX or IPG sources, Raytools, BOCI or Precitec heads, Cypcut controls, Hiwin guides, YYC racks and Schneider electrics — inspected before they ship, with a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty, operator training and parts and service from Mississauga, ON, Canada.
